blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) has opened the application for the 2027 import quotas for five commodities, including pork and chicken. According to the notice posted on its website, the agency said interested parties may submit their applications under the minimum access volume (MAV) for calendar year 2027.
